title: Vintage Pokémon Card Bundle EX Era
description: Vintage English Pokémon card bundle featuring six cards from EX-era sets: Starmie, Feraligatr, Mightyena, Bellossom, Ariados and Mantine. Includes stamped cards from EX Delta Species, EX Holon Phantoms, EX Unseen Forces and EX Team Rocket Returns.

title: Vintage Pokémon 120 Card Bundle
description: 120 vintage English Pokémon cards from Base Set, Jungle, Fossil, Team Rocket and Legendary Collection. Includes holo cards, promos, commons, some first edition cards, Trainers and Energy cards. The seller estimates most cards are LP to MP, with overall condition ranging from LP to HP.

title: Mega Lucario EX + 3 Other Lucario Cards
description: Four-card English Pokémon bundle featuring M Lucario EX 55/111 from XY Furious Fists, Lucario 63/124 Reverse Holo from Diamond & Pearl, Lucario XY140 Cosmos Holo Promo, and Lucario 63 from Fates Collide Cosmos Holo. Main card is Lightly Played; additional cards range from LP/MP to HP, with creases on two cards.

title: Vintage Pikachu McDonald's 2017 Promo Sealed
description: English Pikachu 005/012 Holo Promo from the McDonald's 2017 set. Advertised as original sealed and in mint condition.

title: Pokémon TCG Shrouded Fable Elite Trainer Box - Sealed
description: English Pokémon TCG Scarlet & Violet—Shrouded Fable Elite Trainer Box, released in 2024. Factory sealed. Includes 9 Shrouded Fable booster packs, a full-art Pecharunt promo card, 65 card sleeves, 45 Energy cards, dice, condition markers, dividers, a collector's box and a Pokémon TCG Live code card. Visible packaging wear and creasing are present, so please inspect all photos carefully.

title: Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Pokémon Center Elite Trainer Box
description: Commemorate 30 years of joy with fan-favorite Pokémon spanning three dazzling decades! Celebrate this magnificent milestone with the mighty presences of Mewtwo ex and Mew ex, followed by a wealth of allies like Umbreon ex, Salamence ex, and Greninja ex. Plus, there are 30 reasons to honor Pikachu, as each booster pack contains one—with 30 unique variations to collect as Pikachu rare cards! And, whether you’re looking forward to a glittering future or taking a nostalgic look at a storied past, there are a host of treasures to find and secrets to reveal in the Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration!

title: Yugioh Card Bundle First Editions, Limited Editions, Holos, Commons. Read Desc.
description: English Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG bundle of approximately 100 cards, including numerous 1st Edition and Limited Edition cards, around 20 holographic cards, and a mixture of monsters, spells and traps. The seller estimates approximately £50 in card value, with at least 20 cards believed to be worth several pounds each. Some potentially underpriced 1st Edition cards may offer good value for collectors, resellers and players. Cards are Lightly Played (LP), with no creases, tears or similar damage reported. Photos show examples of the included cards; inspect them carefully. Cards will be shipped sleeved, top-loaded, team-bagged and protected in a padded envelope.

title: Pokemon Card Bundle Tauros Lapras GX Charizard EX Trev. BREAK Read Desc.
description:
English Pokémon TCG bundle of 5 cards:
- Trevenant BREAK 66/122
- Tauros GX 100/149
- Lapras GX 35/149
- Lapras GX 139/149
- Charizard EX 11/106

The seller estimates the cards' combined market value at £35+. Cards are described as Lightly Played to Near Mint (LP/NM), with no creases, tears or similar damage reported. Please inspect the photos to judge condition for yourself. Cards will be shipped sleeved, top-loaded, team-bagged and protected in a padded bubble-wrap envelope.

title: Double Colorless Energy 90/108 Evolutions International Championships Stamped
description: English Pokémon TCG Double Colorless Energy 90/108 from XY Evolutions (2016), featuring the exclusive International Championships stamp. Illustrated by Keiji Kinebuchi. The seller describes the card as Lightly Played to Near Mint, with no creases, tears or similar damage. Please inspect the photos carefully to judge the condition. Ships sleeved, top-loaded and team-bagged in a padded bubble-wrap envelope. The seller notes previous sales in the UK and elsewhere, making this an interesting addition for collectors of championship-stamped Pokémon cards.

title: Vintage Mightyena - (Cosmos Holo) 018/108 Deck Exclusives Holo
description: Vintage English Pokémon TCG Mightyena Cosmos Holo card, number 018/108, from the Deck Exclusives release (2007). Illustrated by Midori Harada. A vintage holo card for Pokémon collectors. Please inspect the listing photographs carefully to assess the card's condition.

title: Vintage Pokemon Emerald Card Bundle Various Card LP/MP Read Desc.
description: Vintage English Pokémon TCG card bundle featuring various cards from the EX Emerald set (2005), including Blaziken, Sceptile, Vulpix, Mudkip, Kyogre, Gulpin and other Pokémon and Trainer cards. The seller describes the cards as ranging from Lightly Played to Moderately Played (LP/MP). Fronts are generally in better condition than backs, with some scuffed backs and creases on Kyogre and Gulpin. These two cards are included essentially free and do not affect the asking price. Cards will be shipped sleeved, top-loaded, team-bagged and protected in a padded bubble-wrap envelope. Please inspect all photographs carefully to judge the condition.
